# Dorf decision guide

Start with the [documentation map](../README.md) and the current authority for the work. Use this guide when you need the rationale behind a current boundary.

Choose the section for the boundary you are changing, scan the `Read when` triggers, and open only matching records. If a task names a decision ID, search this guide for that ID. A record may appear under several areas, but its linked file remains the single source.

Each linked file keeps routing metadata next to the authoritative decision and its history. Follow the [decision procedure](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#record-a-decision) when a choice changes.

`current` decisions still govern. `partial` decisions retain a boundary that a later decision changed in part.
